stories.title: Opening Night Complete Guide — Tripleheader on NBC Starts Tomorrow

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
**Post 1** (9:00 AM ET)
Tomorrow. Basketball is BACK. 🏀

Opening Night tripleheader on NBC:
3 PM — Celtics at Pistons
7 PM — Sixers at Knicks (banner night!)
9:30 PM — Thunder at Spurs

53 years in the making for the Knicks. LeBron at MSG. Do NOT miss it.

stories.title: Chet Holmgren Ruled OUT for Opening Night — Quad Contusion Keeps Him Sidelined

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
**Post 3** (1:00 PM ET)
Holmgren is OUT for Opening Night.

Quad contusion sidelined him all preseason. The Thunder face Wembanyama tomorrow without him.

Hartenstein steps up. OKC opens its title defense one man short.

#ThunderUp

stories.title: LeBron James Joins the Sixers — Opening Night at MSG Is His Moment

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
**Post 5** (11:00 AM ET)
Tomorrow night at MSG:

The Knicks raise their first banner since 1973.
LeBron James makes his 76ers debut.
Jaylen Brown debuts for Philly too.

This is not a normal Opening Night game. This is a moment.

#Sixers #KnicksNation

Celtics vs. Pistons, 3 PM on NBC. The season starts NOW.

#Celtics
